summary: Tiny strip of bays outside Parliament House, loading zone signed, very conspicuous.
reasons: Four bays plus hatching, no space for a van

drivers.seclusion: Directly in front of Parliament House, with a private club behind; highly visible and likely patrolled.
drivers.access_and_room: Short row of angled bays, mostly occupied, with hatched markings at the south end; nothing a van could take.
drivers.traffic: Quiet precinct road; city traffic beyond the trees.
drivers.convention: Sign reads Loading Zone Passengers, 2 min max; bays serve the parliamentary precinct.

flags: Signs vs imagery: Loading Zone sign next to what looks like staff or visitor bays
Bollards mapped 12 m and 22 m away restrict through access
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy to the north-east; open to the south-west.
